question: Does recall 17V706000 apply to my 2017 Civic hatchback?

answer.text:
No. Recall 17V706000 (right front halfshaft that may not have been heat-treated properly) covers only some 2017 Civic sedans and coupes. It doesn't include the hatchback.

NHTSA does list other 2017 Civic recalls that name the hatchback, or that cover all Civics:
- 18V817000: the owner's guide may be missing or have wrong child-seat anchor information (hatchback and Type R)
- 18V266000: replacement front seatback pads that could block the side air bags (hatchback and Type R)
- 23V858000: the fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (includes Civic hatchback)
- 26V332000: the front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and affect how the air bags deploy (includes 2017–2021 Civic hatchback)
- 18V663000: a power-steering sensor problem (listed for 2017–2018 Civic, body style not specified)

Each recall covers only certain vehicles, so it may not include your car. To check your exact car, enter your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls, or send me the VIN and I can confirm the details. Repairs are free at Honda dealers (1-888-234-2138).
